page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.4xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance belonging to the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It delivers 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The configuration provides zero integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for all persistent data and operating system installations. There are no GPU accelerators included. Baseline network performance is rated at 12 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default.

The 1:4 compute-to-memory profile delivers consistent resource density for enterprise software stacks that rely on dedicated host execution rather than shared CPU cycles. Because local disks are absent, input/output operations depend on remote block storage, trading ultra-low disk latency for decoupled storage management. This profile is engineered for general-purpose workloads, including medium-scale application tiers, web serving, CI/CD pipelines, and relational database nodes backed by network storage.
